appendAuthoredRevision is O(n) per call: it calls loadRevisionChain (revisions.ts:266), which reads and zod-parses EVERY record in the chain, and each record embeds a full authored snapshot. scripts/smoke-revision.ts:88 records this and its boundary test builds 1,002 records. Wiring it into prepare and resolve puts that cost on the operator path, and an authored block with thousands of slot values (stripe: 9,529 slots) makes each record large. Size this before an undo UI.

appendAuthoredRevision writes with flag 'wx' (revisions.ts:289), so two concurrent writers racing for the same position get a hard EEXIST throw rather than a merge. That is the intended safety property, but once prepare/resolve call it, a plain double-invocation becomes an operator-visible failure. There is no locking anywhere in the repo.
